title: List
description: Record rows with actions composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Card, Avatar, Badge, Button, Skeleton and Alert primitives: one row per record with an avatar, a name and a second line, a status badge, a short fact and Edit and Remove buttons, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the header lines up and the buttons move to the row's end at @sm, the status moves into its own column and the heading grows at @md, and the facts line up in one column at @lg.
